svg.aria-label: S21 The four load-store pipelines, stage by stage
svg.text: S21 The four load-store pipelines, stage by stage
A template where a micro-op lights each stage it passes. Two pipes load, one stores and one does either. A zero-cycle load never enters one.
renamed to the register just stored
the value is there at rename
store and load share an address register
three for the store, three or four more
a late store match replays the load
the dependence predictor makes the next one wait
~ inferred: patent reading or author reasoning
